needs.premise: Two release rights with common function/pointer identity; bounded slots and native-byte credits; roots and known outcome are abstract predicates; no real allocation, effect interpreter or whole-GC liveness
20 conditional declarations: disjoint credit Step/Trace conservation, admission rejection and retirement gates; no complete QNT-to-C simulation

Lexical closed-repository runtime registrations, generated converter templates, explicit/rollback/teardown origins and custom example declarations must be enumerated; arbitrary C converters, c-declare, dynamic modules and exported APIs remain open-world until registered; installed configuration not inferred

Bind exact release code/library/config generation, transitive callbacks/locks/allocator/free effects, owner/VM/processor/thread affinity and typed disposal to each producing right; unknown effects/affinity or invalid rollback target refuses deferred admission

Atomically reserve slot/root/code/wait/handle/native-byte capacity before native production; every wrapped, in-flight, queued and terminal-retained right occupies one disjoint ticket; finite descendant bounds or same-ticket resumable continuation required; no refund from ACK/unknown result

Declare dependency shape at profile registration; root and pin concrete dependencies before first GC/native escape; trace/relocate current-round roots before cleanup settlement, or counted pre-seal rescan under admitted credit; FOREIGN opacity, RC teardown and profile/code readers require real closure

Explicit foreign-release!, value-conversion rollback and library/device constructor rollback retain synchronous outcome/visibility unless separately proven equivalent; GC deferral needs legal delay, teardown needs service drain; no-op/permanent wrappers create zero release jobs

C release/acquire publish immutable profile and accepted ticket before source detach; close producer gate then acquire all reservations; generation-safe root/slot/code retirement after readers/children; stop/unknown foreign effects remain platform obligations

Every admitted strong/weak/private/cleanup duty closes or has qualified deferred handoff; capacity success or safe-error outcome, context preparation, result delivery, binding, writer closure and current generation precede active permit; domain-wide finalizer inventory required

Reserve before destructive wrapper retirement; canonical task owns payload/dependencies/credits and accepted decision before source drops custody; queue notification or transport loss is not acceptance/completion

Foreign payload is opaque to scan; deferred managed dependencies must already be traced and rooted or trigger pre-seal rescan; native/RC/code/library storage survives actual cleanup_rc and old-reader drain

Only qualified native-only execution may overlap GC; owner/managed callback waits until active permit and rooted activation, while cleanup never waits for that callback; explicit WaitContext replaces PSTATE scratch

GC, explicit foreign-release!, constructor rollback and teardown have different invocation/error/timing contracts; at-most-once invocation preserved and delay permission is explicit, not inferred from unreachable wrapper

Unknown handoff/root/writer/capacity/binding/gate states refuse resume; isolated native result unknown may retain resources while GC resumes; typed effect/disposition forbids replay or refund inferred from scalar error
Release/acquire handoff/terminal/seal publication, code/root/native pin drain, generation wrap and external effect/stop boundary require actual C/platform refinement; no arbitrary owner-death repair

admissionCosts.removedWork: Move only admitted legal-delay bodies Fi out of collective cleanup
admissionCosts.bound: Delta critical work = sum eligible(Fi-Hi)-profile/root/ledger cost; serial comparison only
admissionCosts.addedCost: One handoff per right plus roots/rescan; scheduler contention
admissionCosts.condition: Positive only if saved body work exceeds these costs; zero measured speedup

admissionCosts.removedWork: Share one persistent ticket across producer/wrapper/queue/terminal states
admissionCosts.bound: M=sum disjoint Constructing+Wrapped+Queued+Running+Retained; not distinct function count
admissionCosts.addedCost: O(M) ticket/receipt slots and generation metadata
admissionCosts.condition: Two equal release functions or RC payload addresses can still require two release rights

admissionCosts.removedWork: Avoid collector allocation/waiting for owner to free queue capacity
admissionCosts.bound: For each resource dimension k: sum live q_i[k]+inflight descendant reserve <= pool[k]
admissionCosts.condition: Reserve before first native effect; unknown size/fanout refuses bounded profile

admissionCosts.removedWork: Reuse same slot when transferring one duty; no second queue payload copy required
admissionCosts.bound: Pool = M*slotBytes + rootCells*rootCellBytes + waitBytes + receipts + allocator overhead
admissionCosts.addedCost: Resident pre-reserved storage can increase low-load peak
admissionCosts.condition: Logical credit cap requires actual physical backing proof; no numeric byte estimate without layouts

admissionCosts.removedWork: Account resources ignored by Scheme wrapper size
admissionCosts.addedCost: Delay can retain payload longer; unknown outcomes can retain indefinitely
admissionCosts.condition: Do not sum independent maxima, double-count already physical reserved bytes or refund on queue ACK

admissionCosts.removedWork: Reuse registered dependency handles; avoid re-discovery during destructor
admissionCosts.bound: R dependency cells scanned/relocated; late managed edges require counted pre-seal rescan
admissionCosts.addedCost: Instance registration before possible GC; weak/strong ordering
admissionCosts.condition: Descriptor alone not root instance or current trace receipt; opaque FOREIGN not a managed root

admissionCosts.removedWork: Share immutable effect/affinity descriptor per code/config generation
admissionCosts.bound: O(P) descriptors plus O(M) generation references
admissionCosts.addedCost: Configuration-change revocation, external alias audit, library pins
admissionCosts.condition: Code descriptor dedup permitted; per-instance release rights cannot be deduplicated

admissionCosts.removedWork: Reuse typed disposition/custody support while preserving caller boundary
admissionCosts.bound: No work reduction claimed for synchronous origins; three value rollback protocols
admissionCosts.addedCost: Preflight adaptation in CFUN/SFUN plus each direct constructor
admissionCosts.condition: No legal timing/error equivalence means no delayed job admission

admissionCosts.removedWork: One generator protocol can cover arbitrarily many generated value releases
admissionCosts.bound: 12 os_io registrations + 1 permanent-null setup expression; 3 value templates; 4 example custom types
admissionCosts.addedCost: Open custom converters/C API require registration; platform predicates remain
admissionCosts.condition: Counts are source inventory, never active Darwin leaf coverage or speedup

admissionCosts.removedWork: Replace ambiguous failure ownership with exact return-slot custody
admissionCosts.bound: Three lexical blockers: Win32 event return, process conversion failure, accepted-client/server mismatch
admissionCosts.addedCost: Source corrections and independent failure-path evidence
admissionCosts.condition: No implementation done; do not assign resource leak frequency or observable impact without native evidence

admissionCosts.removedWork: Use shared drain/transfer barrier instead of implicit PSTATE lifetime
admissionCosts.bound: No live ticket/code/root reader when withdrawing scanning/RC/native service
admissionCosts.addedCost: Ordered shutdown DAG; owner dispatch must not wait round seal cyclically
admissionCosts.condition: Unknown task disposition/root transfer refuses teardown, not automatic refund

admissionCosts.removedWork: Scheme emits one typed ReleaseSpec and modern C adapters
admissionCosts.bound: Zero extra runtime-work saving established for Zig
admissionCosts.addedCost: Both need same profile, credit, root, ABI and memory-order proofs
admissionCosts.condition: Modern C mandatory; Zig optional only with independently demonstrated incremental benefit

nodes.labelText: Scheme generator / native constructor\nprofile + origin + result slot
Atomic vector budget reservation\nbefore native resource creation
Instance dependency registration\nbefore first possible GC / escape
Native effect + conversion\nsame ticket; synchronous rollback
Producer close + acquired ledger\nin-flight reservations remain charged
Current-round dependency trace\nor counted pre-seal rescan
Qualified executor / owner dispatch\nexplicit WaitContext + code pin
Known disposition + readers/children drain\nphysical free then budget refund
Unknown profile / rollback owner / roots\nreject deferral; retain known source custody
